# Libraries

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readxl)


theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 16))
```

# Data preparation

We read the whole time series available (not only data from 1987 used for the model fit). 


```{r}

# ui: yearly from 1948 to 2021

ui <- read_excel(file.path("..","data","Procesos_ambientales_anchoa_LI.xlsx"), sheet="UI")

ui <- ui %>% 
  rename(year=AÑO) %>% 
  mutate(month=1, date=as.Date(paste0(year, "-01-01"), "%Y-%m-%d"),
         quarter=lubridate::quarter(date),
         semester=lubridate::semester(date)) %>%  
  select(year, date, UI)


# turb: monthly from 1948/01 to 2021/12

turb <- read_excel(file.path("..","data","Procesos_ambientales_anchoa_LI.xlsx"), sheet="TURB")

turb <- turb %>% 
  rename(year=AÑO, month=MES) %>% 
  mutate(date=as.Date(paste0(year, "-", month, "-01"), "%Y-%m-%d"),
         quarter=lubridate::quarter(date),
         semester=lubridate::semester(date)) %>% 
  select(year, month, quarter, semester, date, TURB)

# compute turbulence per year

turb <- turb %>%
  group_by(year) %>% 
  summarise(TURB.mean=mean(TURB, na.rm=T),
            TURB.min=min(TURB, na.rm=T),
            TURB.max=max(TURB, na.rm=T),
            TURB.sd=sqrt(var(TURB, na.rm=T)),
            TURB.q1=mean(TURB[quarter==1], na.rm=T),
            TURB.q2=mean(TURB[quarter==2], na.rm=T),
            TURB.q3=mean(TURB[quarter==3], na.rm=T),
            TURB.q4=mean(TURB[quarter==4], na.rm=T),
            TURB.s1=mean(TURB[semester==1], na.rm=T),
            TURB.s2=mean(TURB[semester==2], na.rm=T)) %>% 
  as.data.frame()

# merge two datasets (ui and turb)

df <- merge(ui, turb, by=c("year"))
df <- df %>% 
  mutate(logUI=log(UI),
         logTURB.q3=log(TURB.q3))
names(df)

```
# Upwelling index

Decomposition of log(UI):

```{r}
# plot logUI
ggplot(df, aes(year, logUI))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_line()+
  geom_smooth(method="lm", col="grey")


# linear model
m.lm <- lm(logUI ~ year, data=df)
summary(m.lm)

# check with the spectrum analysis some tentaive values for the periodic term

aux <- spectrum(df$logUI, log="no", plot=TRUE)
1/aux$freq[which.max(aux$spec)] # approximately at 18.75 years

# models accounting for linear trend and periodic shape 
# which period gives the best fit?

pvector <- c(5:40)
mod.list <- vector("list", length=length(pvector))
r2vector <- NULL
for (i in 1:length(pvector)){
  p <- pvector[i]
  mod <- lm(logUI ~ sin(2*pi*year/p) + cos(2*pi*year/p) + year, data=df) 
  # print(summary(mod))
  mod.list[[i]] <- mod
  r2vector <- c(r2vector, summary(mod)$adj.r.squared)
}

# plot all fitted models

par(mfrow=c(6,6), mar=c(2,2,2,0))
for (i in 1:length(pvector)){
  plot(df$year, df$logUI, type="l", lty=1, main=paste("Period", pvector[i]))
  lines(df$year, predict(mod.list[[i]]), lty=2, col=2)
}
par(mfrow=c(1,1), mar=c(5, 4, 4, 2) + 0.1) # back to default

# find the model with larger R2

plot(pvector, r2vector, type="b")

# the model with larger R2:

idx <- which.max(r2vector)
data.frame(pvector, r2vector)[idx,]

# see the fitted model in detail

pvector[idx]
summary(mod.list[[idx]])

# we could even remove one term more (non significant) in the model

p <- pvector[idx]
mod <- lm(logUI ~ sin(2*pi*year/p) + year, data=df) 
summary(mod)

plot(df$year, df$logUI, xlab="", ylab="log(UI)", type="o")
lines(df$year, predict(mod.list[[idx]]), col=2)
lines(df$year, predict(mod), col=3)

plot(resid(mod), xlab="", ylab="Residuals")
abline(h=0)

acf(resid(mod))
arima(resid(mod), c(1,0,0), include.mean=F)


```

Prediction

```{r}
set.seed(333) # set the seed

pred.ui <- data.frame(year=2022:2099)
pred.ui$UI <- rlnorm(nrow(pred.ui),
                     predict(mod, newdata=pred.ui), 
                     sd=summary(mod)$sigma)

plot(df$year, log(df$UI), type="o", col=1, pch=19, xlim=c(1948,2099), xlab="", ylab="logUI", ylim=range(c(log(df$UI), log(pred.ui$UI)), na.rm=T))
lines(pred.ui$year, log(pred.ui$UI), type="o", pch=19, col=2)

plot(df$year, df$UI, type="o", col=1, pch=19, xlim=c(1948,2099), xlab="", ylab="UI", ylim=c(0, max(df$UI, pred.ui$UI)))
lines(pred.ui$year, pred.ui$UI, type="o", pch=19, col=2)
```

# Turbulence

Decomposition of log(TURB.q3):

```{r}
# plot logUI
ggplot(df, aes(year, logTURB.q3))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_line()+
  geom_smooth(method="lm", col="grey")


# linear model
m.lm <- lm(logTURB.q3 ~ year, data=df)
summary(m.lm)

# check with the spectrum analysis some tentaive values for the periodic term

aux <- spectrum(df$logTURB.q3, log="no", plot=TRUE)
1/aux$freq[which.max(aux$spec)] # approximately at 37 years

# models accounting for linear trend and periodic shape 
# which period gives the best fit?

pvector <- c(5:40)
mod.list <- vector("list", length=length(pvector))
r2vector <- NULL
for (i in 1:length(pvector)){
  p <- pvector[i]
  mod <- lm(logTURB.q3 ~ sin(2*pi*year/p) + cos(2*pi*year/p) + year, data=df) 
  # print(summary(mod))
  mod.list[[i]] <- mod
  r2vector <- c(r2vector, summary(mod)$adj.r.squared)
}

# plot all fitted models

par(mfrow=c(6,6), mar=c(2,2,2,0))
for (i in 1:length(pvector)){
  plot(df$year, df$logTURB.q3, type="l", lty=1, main=paste("Period", pvector[i]))
  lines(df$year, predict(mod.list[[i]]), lty=2, col=2)
}
par(mfrow=c(1,1), mar=c(5, 4, 4, 2) + 0.1) # back to default

# find the model with larger R2

plot(pvector, r2vector, type="b")

# the model with larger R2: 

idx <- which.max(r2vector)
data.frame(pvector, r2vector)[idx,]

# see the fitted model in detail

pvector[idx]
summary(mod.list[[idx]])

# we could even remove one term more (non significant) in the model
# we keep the linear term although is not significant

p <- pvector[idx]
mod <- lm(logTURB.q3 ~ cos(2*pi*year/p) + year, data=df) 
summary(mod)

plot(df$year, df$logTURB.q3, xlab="", ylab="log(TURB.q3)", type="o")
lines(df$year, predict(mod.list[[idx]]), col=2)
lines(df$year, predict(mod), col=3)

plot(resid(mod), xlab="", ylab="Residuals")
abline(h=0)

acf(resid(mod))
arima(resid(mod), c(1,0,0), include.mean=F)


```

Prediction

```{r}
set.seed(555) # set the seed

pred.turb <- data.frame(year=2022:2099)
pred.turb$TURB.q3 <- rlnorm(nrow(pred.turb),
                     predict(mod, newdata=pred.turb), 
                     sd=summary(mod)$sigma)

plot(df$year, log(df$TURB.q3), type="o", col=1, pch=19, xlim=c(1948,2099), xlab="", ylab="logTURB.q3", ylim=range(c(log(df$TURB.q3), log(pred.turb$TURB.q3)), na.rm=T))
lines(pred.turb$year, log(pred.turb$TURB.q3), type="o", pch=19, col=2)

plot(df$year, df$TURB.q3, type="o", col=1, pch=19, xlim=c(1948,2099), xlab="", ylab="TURB.q3", ylim=c(0, max(df$TURB.q3, pred.turb$TURB.q3)))
lines(pred.turb$year, pred.turb$TURB.q3, type="o", pch=19, col=2)
```

# Save dataset

```{r}
pred <- merge(pred.ui, pred.turb, by="year")
saveRDS(pred, file="results/ui_turb_projection.RDS")
```
